items.title: Indie Aesthetic Teens
items.creator: CubeCraft Games
items.description:
It's time to set a trend with these super fashionable outfits! Show your friends how stylish you are and become one of the cool kids with the indie aesthetic! 

+ 8 teen skins!
+ 1 FREE skin: Niven

By CubeCraft Games

items.title: Timeless Toys Skins
items.creator: Minecraft
items.description: Are you toying around with the idea of setting yourself apart from the crowd? Use the Battle Buds, Bearitone, Buildosaur or Pose-a-Bill skin from the Timeless Toys Skins to help you do that! Have fun with these one-of-a-kind skins available to those who cannot stop thinking about playing around.

items.title: Halloween Adventure
items.creator: In Mine
items.description:
Journey to a castle covered in Endless Night, explore, fight, collect equipment for battle in giant pumpkin and get Pumpkin Diamond Set!

+ Scary
+ Parkour Courses
+ Pumpkin Diamonds!!!
+ Partially reskined mobs
+ Endless Night
+ 3 bonus skins
+ By In Mine

2022 Update!
+ Dark Netherite Tools, Weapons and Armor!

items.title: A Teen's Halloween
items.creator: G2Crafted
items.description:
Who says you're too old for Halloween? And who says Halloween needs to be scary? This year, it's a teen's Halloween, and a teen just wants to have fun! Boo!
Includes 10 skins
1 FREE skin
Created by G2Crafted

items.title: Goth-O-Ween
items.creator: G2Crafted
items.description:
Let your alter ego go with this skin pack depicting Halloween tales. You are now free to become a VooDoo Queen, Dracula, a Plague Doctor, or more. Let the scaring begin!
Includes 10 skins
1 free
Created by G2Crafted

items.title: Camp Roleplay
items.creator: Tomhmagic Creations
items.description:
Welcome to Camp Wilderness! This camp roleplay map has tons of mini-games and multiplayer fun. From parkour rock climbing to quad bike racing around the lake, there’s something for everyone!

This map’s activities include:
-Trading card collecting
-Arts & crafts
-Archery contest
-Rock climbing
-Golf
-Soccer
-Horseback riding
-Butterfly catching
-Fishing
-Custom food/snacks

items.title: Mobs Armor
items.creator: Cubed Creations
items.description:
Collect resources, craft new armor and equip it to the right mob! Each piece has abilities and are craftable in iron, gold & diamond! Use the goat rockets to knock people far away, the fox magnet to collect blocks, the llama mask to spit fire, the panda to shoot rockets and the pig glasses to fire lasers!

+All craftable!
+Cool abilities!
+30 new mob armor pieces!

items.title: Neon Nightmare
items.creator: Pixelationz Studios
items.description: Whether you're a spooky skeleton or a terrifying ghoul, give your friends a fright with these eight scary monster skins that only a nightmare could create!

items.title: Haunted Horrors
items.creator: Pixelationz Studios
items.description: Want to play a trick on your friends? Or do you need a scary costume for your Halloween party? Then this bundle of eight horror-themed skins will be perfect for the occasion.

items.title: Kiki Textures
items.creator: Mine-North
items.description:
Upgrade your Minecraft survival experience with these colorful new textures! Make your world even more vibrant and charming!

+ Updated to v1.21 textures
+ Super cute textures

items.title: Rainbow Buddies
items.creator: Rainbow Theory
items.description:
It's time to explore the bright and beautiful city in a trendy outfit. Paint the world with a splash of color, and share your love of the rainbow with this fun and radiant pack! There's a color for everyone!

- 6 Rainbow Skins!
- By Rainbow Theory Studios and Rio Eyo Studios

items.title: Fairytale
items.creator: Rainbow Theory
items.description:
Deep in the forest, a magical world of fantasy awaits! From the mushroom folk to the solitary witches, this land is filled with mystery. Stories unfold, with courageous heroes, brave warriors, and evil villains. Unlock your inner fantasy fairytale story today!

- 12 Fairytale Skins!
- By Rainbow Theory Studios and Rio Eyo Studios

items.title: Halloween Ninjas
items.creator: Rainbow Theory
items.description:
In the dead of night, they arrive. It's the Halloween Ninjas! Protecting the world from midnight terrors without ever getting caught, these ninjas are scarily silent. Become a fighting master today!

- 11 Ninja Skins!
- +1 Free skin!
- By Rainbow Theory Studios and Rio Eyo Studios

items.title: Zombie World
items.creator: Cyclone
items.description:
Surviving's not easy in a world of zombies, but people get by. Pick your favourite car and travel between cities, fight hordes of zombie mobs and upgrade your gear to face elites, raid zombie nests and face the sinister flamestalker.

+ 6 custom weapons
+ 8 custom cars
+ 26 new Zombie mobs, including 6 bosses
+ 70+ missions and objectives

items.title: Hostile Glitches
items.creator: Pathway Studios
items.description:
The bad news? There's a glitch in the system. The good news? It's you. This skin pack of computer viruses brought to life will add some colorful chaos to any network. Are you ready to hack the system?

- Includes 8 vivid HD skins
- Every "virus" depicted looks like it's buzzing with electricity!
- By SmartPixel & Pathway Studios

items.title: Masks on Suits
items.creator: Pathway Studios
items.description:
It's time to suit up and don a mask -- not for any kind of heroics, but for a night of fun masquerading! With some of the most stylish suits and colorful masks, this skin pack of sharp-dressed individuals will make you the life of any occasion.

- Includes 8 sophisticated skins
- Each suit has its own unique design and mask pairing
- By SmartPixel & Pathway Studios

items.title: Biome Gods
items.creator: Pathway Studios
items.description:
Bend air, water, earth, and fire with your mind. Create new oceans, light up the darkest caves, change the tides of the ocean, create new rivers, fill your sail with the wind, shape new mountains, and fly high above your beautiful biome. Become a biome god!

8 Unique Skins.
By Varuna & Pathway Studios

items.title: Autumn Aesthetic 2 Skin Pack
items.creator: CupcakeBrianna
items.description:
These aesthetic autumn cuties are back and ready to party! A stylish collection of orange, brown, black, and cream colors that are perfect for Halloween parties and fall roleplays. 

+ 10 skins
+ By CupcakeBrianna

items.title: Autumn Aesthetic Skin Pack
items.creator: CupcakeBrianna
items.description:
Be the most stylish teen on your server during autumn with this aesthetic skin pack! Comes with an array of orange, black, brown, and cream colors that are also great for Halloween parties and roleplays.

+ 10 skins
+ By CupcakeBrianna

items.title: Sci-Fi Skyland
items.creator: UnderBlocks Studios
items.description:
Now is your turn to create your empire and defeat the galactic boss, create your base, trade with special creatures, and get ores from a new generator system.

+3 skins
+Special swords
+Have your own galactic pet
+Skyland experience
by UnderBlocks

items.description:
These mobs are out at night and ready to fight. Better watch your back this season!

*1 Free Skin
